harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1 (RHEL 10), built a local package repository from local storage and served it over HTTP via a systemd-managed python3 http.server bound to the node's own IP on port 8080, then made the usual remote RHEL repositories (Red Hat CDN, cdn.redhat.com) unreachable both in dnf config and at the network level, verified that unreachability, and installed the `tree` package purely from the local repo. Restarted node1 and confirmed the boot identity changed while the local repo service, installed package, and blocked-remote-repo state all persisted and recovered.
actions_performed: Captured baseline: redhat.repo present with two enabled remote repos, cdn.redhat.com reachable, tree package not installed
Installed createrepo_c and downloaded tree-2.1.0-8.el10 (with deps) into /srv/localrepo while remote repos were still reachable
Ran createrepo_c on /srv/localrepo to build repo metadata and added /etc/yum.repos.d/local.repo pointing at http://$NODE_IP:8080/
Created and enabled systemd unit local-repo-httpd.service to serve /srv/localrepo via python3 http.server bound to NODE_IP; opened firewalld port 8080/tcp
Verified the local repo was servable over HTTP (repomd.xml returned 200)
Disabled the two remote RHEL repos via dnf config-manager and blackholed cdn.redhat.com via /etc/hosts; confirmed both curl and dnf makecache against the remote repo failed to connect
Installed tree via dnf with only local-repo enabled; confirmed the transaction sourced the package from local-repo
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, local-repo-httpd active, tree installed, local repo HTTP 200, remote repo disabled/unreachable
Issued a native systemd reboot on node1 with the acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec access returned and confirmed the boot_id changed (646e5f74... -> 0678901e...)

Verified post-restart recovery: local-repo-httpd.service auto-started and active, local repo still served (HTTP 200), tree package still installed and functional (tree --version), remote repos still disabled and cdn.redhat.com still unreachable

evidence.requirement: Local package repository served from local storage on node1
evidence.summary: systemd unit local-repo-httpd.service created and started, serving /srv/localrepo via python3 http.server bound to NODE_IP:8080; firewalld port opened; curl to http://$NODE_IP:8080/repodata/repomd.xml returned http_code=200

evidence.requirement: Usual remote repositories made unreachable and proven so
evidence.summary: Remote RHEL repos disabled via dnf config-manager and cdn.redhat.com blackholed via /etc/hosts; curl to https://cdn.redhat.com failed with 'Could not connect to server' and dnf makecache against the remote repo failed with the same connect error

evidence.requirement: Package installed from the local repository while remote repos unreachable
evidence.summary: dnf install -y --disablerepo=* --enablerepo=local-repo tree completed, with the transaction table showing Repository: local-repo; rpm -q tree confirmed installed

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline captured for node1
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 646e5f74-dc0e-45e7-9746-226c4351af28, local-repo-httpd active, tree installed, local repo HTTP 200, remote repo disabled and cdn.redhat.com blocked

evidence.requirement: Node1 restarted with acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded systemd reboot trigger acknowledged immediately ('reboot scheduled') before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: Node1 boot identity proven changed after restart
evidence.summary: Polling showed connection timeouts/resets during reboot, then exec succeeded again with a new boot_id 0678901e-38c1-41dc-b5d0-f9f5612746de, differing from the pre-restart boot_id

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of local repo service, installed package, and remote-unreachable state on node1
evidence.summary: After restart: local-repo-httpd.service active (auto-started via enable), local repo HTTP 200, tree package present and functional (tree --version), remote repos still disabled and cdn.redhat.com still unreachable

attempts.summary: On node1 (RHEL 10), built a local package repository from local storage and served it over HTTP via a systemd-managed python3 http.server bound to the node's own IP on port 8080, then made the usual remote RHEL repositories (Red Hat CDN, cdn.redhat.com) unreachable both in dnf config and at the network level, verified that unreachability, and installed the `tree` package purely from the local repo. Restarted node1 and confirmed the boot identity changed while the local repo service, installed package, and blocked-remote-repo state all persisted and recovered.
